title: READ THE SCENE, NOT THE SCRIPT: OUTCOME-AWARE SAFETY FOR LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'consequence-aware reasoning' as a core goal for safety alignment in LLMs. By benchmarking a model's ability to prioritize actual outcome risk (harmfulness) over surface-form signals (semantic risk), the work deals with consequentialism—a major ethical framework—and its application to AI safety and refusal behavior.
